articles.title: Israelis smash turnout records to pass wartime judgment on Netanyahu
articles.description: By Steven Scheer and Alexander CornwellJERUSALEM, Oct 27 (Reuters) - Israelis streamed to the polls on Tuesday in record numbers to pass wartime judgment on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in what some described as the most consequential election in the nation's history.Long lines formed outside polling stations for the first election since the Hamas-led attacks on October 7, 2023, as voters grappled with the trauma of Israel's deadliest day and its ensuing wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

articles.title: Israelis shatter turnout records to pass wartime judgment on Netanyahu

articles.title: Fastest turnout for half a century as Israelis pass wartime judgment on Netanyahu
articles.description: By Steven Scheer and Pesha MagidJERUSALEM, Oct 27 (Reuters) - Israelis surged to the polls at the fastest rate in nearly half a century on Tuesday to pass wartime judgment on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, in what voters described as the most consequential election in the nation's history.Long lines formed outside polling stations for the first election since the October 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks, with voters passionately engaged over the trauma of the country's deadliest day and the ensuing wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
